task_scope: One previously captured Crossref citation lookup task from source ID GAP001-01.

outcome_rule.pass: At least one provider-returned DOI in the route's top-two rows equals the DOI previously recorded for target_source_id in the cited source manifest.
outcome_rule.fail: No DOI in the route's top-two returned rows equals the prior source-manifest DOI.
outcome_rule.aggregation: For a route with multiple requests, pass if any request returns a matching DOI.

resource_metric.count_basis: Count the observed Crossref requests composing each route. Do not infer wall time, bytes, monetary cost, or reliability.

limitations: The prior source-manifest DOI is a comparison target, not independently authenticated truth.
This is one captured task and one trial; it does not establish general precision, recall, reliability, latency, savings, source authenticity, or scientific support.
The generic-only candidate uses one captured generic response; the duplicate generic request was observed as an identical response recheck.
The route variants are a retrospective analysis of captured results, not four separately randomized live trials.
